Splits a las file into a grid of smaller files.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › filter<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** las, split<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.filter.LasSplitter`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inFile` | LAS file |  |  | The las file to split. |
| `pRows` | int |  | `0` | The number of rows of the grid of pieces. |
| `pCols` | int |  | `0` | The number of columns of the grid of pieces. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outFolder` | output folder |  | The optional folder of the pieces, named as the input file with a number. If not supplied, the folder of the input file is used. |
